subject.title: feat(chat): UX-012 — token usage progress meter

question: Should this protected maintainer PR be retired because current main already has the context-usage instrument, or rebuilt as a new patch for an exact base-of-composer bar?
rationale: The code path has moved, the central token-context visibility problem is already mostly covered, and only maintainers can decide whether the exact visual treatment remains a product requirement.

options.title: Retire as superseded
options.body: Close or mark this branch superseded by the current `context-usage` implementation and keep broader provider/quota work on the open feature issues.

options.title: Rebuild on current composer
options.body: Create a small current-main patch in `ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer.ts` that reuses `getContextNoticeViewModel` and preserves stale-token behavior.

options.title: Keep for broader UX planning
options.body: Leave this PR open only as a maintainer planning artifact while deciding the exact token/quota/composer UI direction.

recommendation.title: Retire as superseded
recommendation.body: Close or mark this branch superseded by the current `context-usage` implementation and keep broader provider/quota work on the open feature issues.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored this PR and has prior merged history on the Control UI context/usage surfaces, making them the best available owner for the feature-direction choice.
